notes: Synthetic CIFAR-10 RF velocity field (no torch dep). Analytic bound is the operator-norm product ‖W2‖_op · ‖W1‖_op. Numerical bound is the sample-max finite-difference estimate over 100 random latents × 5 t-values = 500 perturbations. The selected L_local is the numerical sample-max (the more conservative estimate; the analytic bound is a tighter upper bound on the true operator-norm but does not capture the (1 - tanh^2) Jacobian suppression at random points).
